title: Helmet for riders of Two Wheeler Motor Vehicles (Quality Control) Order, 2020
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / DPIIT
notes: Mandatory ISI Mark + CM/L number. Amendments to IS 4151 must be considered.

title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order
notes: Covers TMT bars and structural steel. Grade and edition must match current QCO schedule.

title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement of Compulsory Registration) Order
notes: NOT Scheme-I. Marking is BIS Standard Mark + R-number. No factory audit for most products.

title: Safety of Household, Commercial and Similar Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2026
notes: Supersedes earlier QCOs. Concurrent running of 2008 edition until transition ends.

title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order
notes: Hallmark applied by BIS-recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centres. Not a factory licence under Scheme-I.

title: Cookware, Utensils and Cans for Foods and Beverages (Quality Control) Order
notes: Standard year (2024) vs QCO implementation dates frequently mismatched in tenders.

title: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003
notes: Long-standing mandatory certification for ordinary Portland and blended cements.
